tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.alchemy_table.d: An apparatus holding the secrets of alchemy. It condenses and sublimates materials into higher forms.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.alchemy_table.q: "Earth, water, fire, and wind, heed my command. Reforge the four elements; reshape the five phases."
jei.teyvat_artifacts.crystal_core: Crystalflies are extremely fragile. Only precise tools can extract their Crystal Cores intact.
jei.teyvat_artifacts.source.chest: Source: Can be found in certain loot chests.
jei.teyvat_artifacts.source.starter: Source: Granted when first joining the world, if starter gifts are enabled in the config.
jei.teyvat_artifacts.source.first_wither: First Wither defeat: Grants a complete five-star Wanderer's Troupe set.
jei.teyvat_artifacts.source.first_dragon: First Ender Dragon defeat: Grants a complete five-star Gladiator's Finale set.
item.teyvat_artifacts.witchs_revelation_: A case once held by Barbeloth, now in your possession. Every oracle, revealed and unrevealed, rests within it. As for whether these oracles can alter fate, Barbeloth's answer is: 'Hehehe... fate's true color cannot be shown so easily. Besides, leaving the future a little suspense is rather nice, isn't it?'
item.teyvat_artifacts.the_little_witchs_:
A dictionary received from Alice and written together by the witches. Officially, it annotates a fable called The Little Witch and the Undying Flame, but in truth it contains tailor-made lessons from the witches.
As they say, overflowing reversal is coursework. Set out with your companions to claim the Crown of Ascension.
item.teyvat_artifacts.lucky_flower.artif: A carefree four-leaf flower that grows in the wild, picked for the belief that it brings good luck.
item.teyvat_artifacts.lucky_feather.arti: A feather from a bird of prey watching the monster in your path, the sort of luck that only sometimes arrives.
item.teyvat_artifacts.lucky_sands.artifa: An hourglass emptied by a hole. The passage of time means little to the carefree.
item.teyvat_artifacts.lucky_goblet.artif: A delicate metal vessel once used to knock down a night thief.
item.teyvat_artifacts.lucky_circlet.arti: A keepsake from a fall into a pit that turned out to be an exiled old clan's hidden cellar.
item.teyvat_artifacts.initiate_flower.ar: A tiny flower, charming and endearing, like early spring in northern Teyvat.
item.teyvat_artifacts.initiate_feather.a: A trinket tied to the hilt of a traveler's first sword, carrying the wielder's simple dream.
A small flower found in the depths of an ancient city, worn proudly as a badge of survival.
item.teyvat_artifacts.adventurer_feather: A feather from a strange bird of a foreign land, rarely seen on this continent.
item.teyvat_artifacts.adventurer_sands.a: Adventurers who linger in the lightless Chasm or lost ancient cities often forget the time.
A trophy from one of an adventurer's expeditions. Though chipped, it remains a prize worth pride.
item.teyvat_artifacts.adventurer_circlet: A headband soaked with sweat and covered in dust. The grime cannot hide an adventurer's pride.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.lucky.4: 4-piece: Picking up an XP orb heals %s health per orb.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.initiate.2: 2-piece: You feel a power from beyond this world...
4-piece: Gain Instant Health %s when opening an unopened loot chest.
item.teyvat_artifacts.traveling_doctor_f: A precious medicinal herb that has lost its medicinal value after being stored for so long.
A hard owl feather, used by night-traveling doctors to take courage from the image of a nocturnal bird of prey.
item.teyvat_artifacts.traveling_doctor_s: A tool for precise timekeeping. To a doctor, even a single second cannot be wasted.
item.teyvat_artifacts.traveling_doctor_g: Once filled with a highly concentrated medicinal extract, it now holds only a strong medicinal scent.
item.teyvat_artifacts.traveling_doctor_c: Useful for tying back loose hair while practicing medicine, and in emergencies for supporting a sprained or broken arm.
item.teyvat_artifacts.resolution_of_sojo: A small jade-blue flower with someone's ribbon tied around its stem.
A blue arrow feather, carrying a traveler's lingering longing as they faded into the distance.
A weathered sundial that silently records the cycles of sun and moon.
A plain white porcelain cup that was once filled with joyful wine.
A willow crown that carries the scent of spring wind.
item.teyvat_artifacts.tiny_miracle_flowe: A flower growing from stone. It splits hard rock because it keeps seeking the light.
item.teyvat_artifacts.tiny_miracle_feath: A feather from an extremely swift bird whose miraculous strike is nearly invisible to the naked eye.
item.teyvat_artifacts.tiny_miracle_sands: It looks like an ordinary hourglass, but its dry grains flow like water when turned.
item.teyvat_artifacts.tiny_miracle_goble: A cup used in folk fortune-telling rites. It can also hold water.
item.teyvat_artifacts.tiny_miracle_circl: A cheap ornament made from peculiar metal brought by a meteor in ancient times.
item.teyvat_artifacts.berserker_flower.a: A finely made flower stained red, strangely fitting the berserker's temperament.
The dark-blue tail feather of a bird once said to herald death, part of it dyed red.
item.teyvat_artifacts.berserker_sands.ar: A device that flows on without mercy, reminding the berserker of their time on the battlefield and in the world.
item.teyvat_artifacts.berserker_goblet.a: A cup made from the bone of an unknown giant beast, a trophy from a brutal fight.
A frightening iron mask half broken in a fight that ignored life and death.
When the instructor wears this flower on the chest, it means there will be no drills today.
item.teyvat_artifacts.instructor_feather: An instructor skilled at dispersing the force of attacks would never let this feather accessory be blown away.
item.teyvat_artifacts.instructor_sands.a: A pocket watch that cannot tell time, fully devoted to training.
Though ordinary to outsiders, to students this tea cup is a symbol of the instructor's authority.
item.teyvat_artifacts.instructor_circlet: A standard instructor cap, an honor granted only to officers who refused promotion.
item.teyvat_artifacts.the_exile_flower.a: A dim flower carried close. Even in exile, it must hold some important meaning.
Not an intentional ornament, merely an unknown bird feather picked up during wandering in the wild.
item.teyvat_artifacts.the_exile_sands.ar: Its crystal face is shattered and all hands are gone, yet its owner still refuses to throw it away.
item.teyvat_artifacts.the_exile_goblet.a: A dull heavy-metal vessel whose outer wall once held gemstones that were later pried away.
A noble circlet with the mark of status slashed by a blade, its former prestige stripped away.
item.teyvat_artifacts.defenders_will_flo: An iris treasured by a guardian, never given to the one they loved.
item.teyvat_artifacts.defenders_will_fea: A feather-shaped pin symbolizing someone's longing to become a sturdy shield.
item.teyvat_artifacts.defenders_will_san: A small tool that shows the current time, the only reference on moonless nights.
item.teyvat_artifacts.defenders_will_gob: A metal container that can hold a liquid used to soothe the loneliness of long watch.
item.teyvat_artifacts.defenders_will_cir: Indigo cloth dyed by night, able to serve as a bandage in emergencies.
item.teyvat_artifacts.brave_heart_flower: A plain little flower worn at the chest, a keepsake from an adventure.
item.teyvat_artifacts.brave_heart_feathe: A bright songbird feather that can bring a little courage.
An old miniature hourglass with no practical use, as elusive as the passing years.
item.teyvat_artifacts.brave_heart_goblet: A rough stone vessel filled only with memories.
item.teyvat_artifacts.brave_heart_circle: A roughly woven grass ring, as precious to some as a king's golden crown.
item.teyvat_artifacts.martial_artist_flo: Only this red flower lets a martial artist briefly forget pain.
item.teyvat_artifacts.martial_artist_fea: A common bird feather; experts use it to practice force, while beginners make it into a fan.
item.teyvat_artifacts.martial_artist_san: A small timer for endurance training, steadier than the flow of sand.
item.teyvat_artifacts.martial_artist_gob: A slightly refined wine cup used only in the ritual before a martial artist enters the arena.
item.teyvat_artifacts.martial_artist_cir: The first lesson is spirit and focus. Tie on the bandana to remember those words.
item.teyvat_artifacts.gambler_flower.art: A gorgeous large flower, big enough to hide the dice prepared in advance.
item.teyvat_artifacts.gambler_feather.ar: The tail feather of a large bird, big enough to hide cards that can turn fate around.
item.teyvat_artifacts.gambler_sands.arti: A broken pocket watch that once blocked a fatal blow for its owner.
item.teyvat_artifacts.gambler_goblet.art: A special single-purpose vessel, though it contains no cheating mechanism.
item.teyvat_artifacts.gambler_circlet.ar: Emerald-blue earrings that help one calmly judge situations and risks to avoid danger.
item.teyvat_artifacts.scholar_flower.art: A dried flower used as a bookmark, steeped in the scent of books.
item.teyvat_artifacts.scholar_feather.ar: A tail feather from some bird used as a writing tool, its base stained with ink that will not wash away.
item.teyvat_artifacts.scholar_sands.arti: A small clock fit for a desk, perhaps the only time reference for a scholar long away from daylight.
item.teyvat_artifacts.scholar_goblet.art: Originally a drinking vessel, now darkened by frequent use washing brushes.
item.teyvat_artifacts.scholar_circlet.ar: Heavy reading damages the reader's eyesight; this custom tool was made to compensate.
item.teyvat_artifacts.prayers_for_thunde: A tiara worn by priests in ancient times. Long years of listening to thunder gave it a strange resistance.
item.teyvat_artifacts.prayers_for_destin: A tiara worn by priests in ancient times. Long years submerged in water gave it a strange resistance.
item.teyvat_artifacts.prayers_for_illumi: A tiara worn by priests in ancient times. Long years licked by flames gave it a strange resistance.
item.teyvat_artifacts.prayers_to_springt: A tiara worn by priests in ancient times. Long years enduring frost gave it a strange resistance.

item.teyvat_artifacts.gladiators_finale_: No one knows why the legendary fighter always wore this flower on his chest. It was the cruel warrior's only weakness.
A dream-feather as free as a falcon. At the end of a legendary life, an unfettered bird placed this feather over his heart.
A timepiece that recorded the years the gladiator spent staining the arena with blood. To him, it marked the path to eventual freedom.
A golden cup from which an ancient gladiator drank the wine of victory. By the moment he fell, it was filled with his own years.
The helmet of an ancient legendary gladiator, stained by countless foes and once proudly cheered by countless spectators.
item.teyvat_artifacts.wanderers_troupe_f: A small flower-shaped badge. If you listen closely, you can almost hear fresh singing and a graceful flute.
A blue-green arrow feather that has not faded or broken through the years, as if carrying the sound of falling beads and flowing water.
item.teyvat_artifacts.wanderers_troupe_s: An hourglass that kept time for the troupe, once sounding briskly. Their performance has now ended.
item.teyvat_artifacts.wanderers_troupe_g: A strangely shaped ancient kettle with strings installed inside, making odd melodies as water flows through it.
item.teyvat_artifacts.wanderers_troupe_c: A weathered yet still brilliant top hat, within which old and melodious music seems to echo.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.wanderers_t: 4-piece: Projectile damage and spell damage dealt +%s%%.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundersoother_flo: A flower that blooms proudly amid thunderous wrath, still granting courage to travelers walking through storms.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundersoother_fea: The badge of a brave hero said to have calmed thunder itself, shaped like a raptor feather soaring through wild lightning.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundersoother_san: A timepiece once held by a warrior who subdued lightning, its thunder crystals falling with time like flashing bolts.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundersoother_gob: The goblet of the thunder-soothing warrior. Legend says the hero once drank violet lightning from it.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundersoother_cir: The crown of the warrior who calmed thunder, won by an ancient hero after defeating the lightning beast that ravaged the land.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.thundersoot: 2-piece: Immune to lightning damage. Lightning spell damage taken -%s%%.
4-piece: After using a lightning spell, each stack grants +%s%% damage, up to %s stacks for %ss.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundering_fury_fl: A violet thunder flower that survived calamity, spared from trampling chaos and the fury of purple flame.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundering_fury_fe: An electrified feather left by the thunderbird after a cruel retribution, still flashing with its furious lightning.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundering_fury_sa: An hourglass used by a tribe that worshiped the thunderbird, now forever stilled after their end.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundering_fury_go: A consecrated ritual cup filled with innocent blood, praying for thunder to echo within until it overflowed with fury.
item.teyvat_artifacts.thundering_fury_ci: A crown once worn by a shaman who worshiped the thunderbird, though piety could not sway the capricious beast.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.thundering_: 2-piece: Lightning spell damage +%s%%. Your lightning spells make targets glow for %ss on hit.
4-piece: Spell cooldown reduction +%s%%. Fully charged bow hits summon lightning and apply Glowing for %ss with Weakness %s and Slowness %s. Lightning spell damage +%s%% against glowing targets.
A flower that blooms in burning flame. Legend says an ancient sage wore it while walking into a sea of fire.
item.teyvat_artifacts.lavawalker_feather: A feather from a solitary bird bathed in flame, seeming to carry the sound of wings beating within wildfire.
item.teyvat_artifacts.lavawalker_sands.a: An hourglass filled with glittering hot sand, flowing away in haste without leaving a brand.
A cup said to endure molten heat. Now it is empty, holding only lingering warmth.
item.teyvat_artifacts.lavawalker_circlet: The crown of a sage who crossed a sea of fire, once reflecting an ancient figure standing firm in waves of heat.
2-piece: Immune to fire and lava damage. Fire spell damage taken -%s%%.
4-piece: After using a fire spell, each stack grants +%s%% damage, up to %s stacks for %ss.
item.teyvat_artifacts.crimson_witch_of_f: A flower touched by the witch who once dreamed of burning all monsters, warmed by nameless tongues of flame.
A feather touched by the witch who dreamed of burning all monsters, endlessly radiating the heat of flame.
A timepiece worn by the witch who dreamed of burning all monsters, flowing with the years she offered to flame.
A vessel of liquid fire left by the witch of flames. The fire within never fades, much like its owner.
A hat once worn by the witch of flames who dreamed of burning all monsters, its broad brim shielding her sight.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.crimson_wit: 2-piece: Fire spell damage +%s%%. Your fire spells make targets glow for %ss on hit.
4-piece: Spell cooldown reduction +%s%%. Fully charged bow hits ignite targets for %ss and apply Glowing for %ss, Weakness %s, and Slowness %s. Fire spell damage +%s%% against glowing targets.
item.teyvat_artifacts.blizzard_strayer_f: A long-extinct glacier flower beaded with frost. Even a solitary hero once bent for this bloom.
A feather that scatters winter, carrying the wingbeat of a raptor crying above snowfields and icy peaks.
item.teyvat_artifacts.blizzard_strayer_s: A timepiece used by the people awaiting their hero. What flows inside is not sand, but unmelted ice.
item.teyvat_artifacts.blizzard_strayer_g: A cup carved from ice, sharp and hard as winter. Its former owner once drank unfrozen wine from it.
item.teyvat_artifacts.blizzard_strayer_c: The crown of an ancient hero who dreamed of conquering ice and snow, proof of courage before a biting winter.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.blizzard_st: 2-piece: Frost spell damage +%s%%. Your frost spells make targets glow for %ss on hit.
4-piece: Spell cooldown reduction +%s%%. Fully charged bow hits freeze targets for %ss and apply Glowing for %ss, Weakness %s, and Slowness %s. Frost spell damage +%s%% against glowing targets.
item.teyvat_artifacts.heart_of_depth_flo: A faded cloak pin, its once-gilded shine worn away by sea wind.
item.teyvat_artifacts.heart_of_depth_fea: A feather borne by sobbing sea wind and crimson waves, its shape and color changed by the years.
item.teyvat_artifacts.heart_of_depth_san: An old copper compass whose needle points forever toward an unreachable shore and an impossible harbor.
item.teyvat_artifacts.heart_of_depth_gob: A faded goblet recovered by chance, its dim surface whispering of days beneath the waves.
item.teyvat_artifacts.heart_of_depth_cir: An old tricorne haunted by the scent of wine and mottled with stubborn stains.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.heart_of_de: 2-piece: Gain Water Breathing and Night Vision while underwater.
4-piece: For %ss after triggering a critical hit, melee damage +%s%% and Crit Damage +%s%%. While in water or rain, damage dealt +%s%% and damage taken -%s%%.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.noblesse_ob: 4-Piece: After triggering a critical hit, increases damage dealt by %s%% for %ss. This effect cannot stack.
item.teyvat_artifacts.noblesse_oblige_fl: A satin flower in glazed colors, still as vivid as the day it was cast aside.
item.teyvat_artifacts.noblesse_oblige_fe: A feather ornament once worn by old Mondstadt nobles on hunts, still standing proud against time.
item.teyvat_artifacts.noblesse_oblige_sa: A pocket watch once owned by old Mondstadt nobility, passed down through a long lineage.
item.teyvat_artifacts.noblesse_oblige_go: A silver urn once owned by old Mondstadt nobles, its empty belly echoing with mournful wind.
item.teyvat_artifacts.noblesse_oblige_ci: A ballroom mask once owned by old Mondstadt nobles, its hollow eyes fixed on lost splendor.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.bloodstaine: 4-Piece: For %ss after defeating a target, grants Regeneration %s and increases damage dealt by %s%%.
item.teyvat_artifacts.bloodstained_chiva: A dried flower blackened by blood and hardened like iron, perhaps a keepsake to its former master.
A raven plume stuck to a knight's cloak, dyed utterly black by repeated bloodshed.
A timepiece once used by a knight, its liquid fully congealed and its purpose lost.
A dull metal goblet held by the Bloodstained Knight, blackened by smoke and dried blood.
An iron mask used by the knight to hide his face, leaving countless guesses beneath it.

item.teyvat_artifacts.maiden_beloved_flo: An eternally tender flower that still gives off fragrance after long years.
item.teyvat_artifacts.maiden_beloved_fea: A feather ornament carrying someone's longing, like a bird traveling far with the wind.
item.teyvat_artifacts.maiden_beloved_san: The hands spin without end, though the years of a cherished maiden do not.
item.teyvat_artifacts.maiden_beloved_gob: A cup for black tea, not strong wine; for sweetness, not bitterness.
item.teyvat_artifacts.maiden_beloved_cir: A well-kept lady's hat that can perfectly hide even wrinkles at the eyes.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.viridescent: 2-Piece: Movement Speed +%s%% and fall damage taken -%s%%.
4-Piece: Sweep attacks deal %s%% damage and ignore %s%% of the target's armor. Triggering one grants +%s%% Attack Speed for %ss.
item.teyvat_artifacts.viridescent_venere: A wildflower once spread across a certain land, taken from the earth and worn by a hunter.
The tail feather of an arrow that once pierced prey in an instant, still smooth and clean.
A curious device once carried by a hunter, forever pointing toward its prey.
A flask once used by the greenwood hunter, much larger inside than it appears.
A proud crown once owned by the greenwood hunter, verdant as wind over the fields.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.archaic_pet: 2-Piece: While holding a shield, grants Resistance %s. Your shield does not enter cooldown.
4-Piece: After successfully blocking damage with a shield, increases damage dealt by %s%%, Crit Rate by %s%%, and Crit Damage by %s%% for %ss.
item.teyvat_artifacts.archaic_petra_flow: A stone flower blooming from towering rock, its petals swaying as if alive.
item.teyvat_artifacts.archaic_petra_feat: A stiff feather from a rocky kite, its dark tip sometimes beaded with cool dew.
item.teyvat_artifacts.archaic_petra_sand: A sundial carved from jade, silently recording the time that has been lost.
item.teyvat_artifacts.archaic_petra_gobl: A gorgeous yet solemn goblet that once held jade dew a thousand years ago.
item.teyvat_artifacts.archaic_petra_circ: A solemn mask carved from dark rock, its hollow eyes staring coldly ahead forever.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.retracing_b: 2-Piece: Increases armor by %s%%, and Resistance effects received are increased by %s level(s).
4-Piece: For each point of armor, increases damage dealt by %s%%.
item.teyvat_artifacts.retracing_bolide_f: An artificial flower forever in bloom. Does it hold life within?
A delicate wooden dart, something that only stops when it reaches its end.
item.teyvat_artifacts.retracing_bolide_s: A delicate pocket watch stopped at a certain moment.
item.teyvat_artifacts.retracing_bolide_g: Water balloons are common at summer festivals, but only this one is so refined.
item.teyvat_artifacts.retracing_bolide_c: A popular mask made in the image of a legendary deity.

item.teyvat_artifacts.tenacity_of_the_mi: A delicate flower made of gold leaf, symbolizing the achievements and honor of its owner.
An eagle plume worn for ceremonies, showing Liyue Harbor's dignity and resolve.
A plain timekeeping tool once standard equipment for the Millelith in an age of war.
A golden vessel used by the Millelith for oaths, still carrying a faint aroma of wine.
An ancient ornate helm that still shines like new after its dust is washed away.

item.teyvat_artifacts.pale_flame_feather: An ominous feather with an exceedingly sharp edge, perhaps symbolizing defiance.
item.teyvat_artifacts.pale_flame_sands.a: A pocket watch whose cover cannot be opened, ticking firmly with passing time.
A delicate cup whose age cannot be guessed from its appearance.
item.teyvat_artifacts.pale_flame_circlet: A mask that hides the face and makes its wearer's expression unknowable.

item.teyvat_artifacts.shimenawas_reminis: A delicate mizuhiki charm said to seal away the power to grant wishes.
An old-fashioned demon-breaking arrow, seemingly treasured by someone for a long time.
A bronze pocket watch decorated with mizuhiki and bells, frozen at an autumn dawn.
A special fortune slip tube with a mechanism for removing unwanted fortunes.
A well-preserved ritual fox mask, forever wearing a mysterious faint smile.
tooltip.teyvat_artifacts.set.emblem_of_s: 4-Piece: For each 1%% increased attack speed, increases Crit Damage by %s%%.
item.teyvat_artifacts.emblem_of_severed_: An ornate tsuba once granted to an oni who is said to have betrayed the Shogun.
A black feather that once belonged to a tengu, treasured by a swordmaster of the past.
A refined inro with violet lacquer on black, adorned with shining shell and fine metalwork.
A refined wine vessel once used by a warrior renowned across the land.
A sturdy kabuto that served as protection for a warrior of noble standing.

A Plume of Luxury from the Husk of Opulent Dreams artifact set.
A Song of Life from the Husk of Opulent Dreams artifact set.
